name: ai-footprint
description: Understand how you use AI. Local-first analytics for AI coding assistants.
author: Zyfolks Technologies (https://zyfolks.com)

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/shared packages/config packages/database packages/analytics packages/collectors
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --force packages/shared packages/config packages/database packages/analytics packages/collectors apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @ai-footprint/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build && npm run hygiene
